t: A third grade activity where students program a floor robot to dance to music.
steps: Find the Robot Dance Party activity on Education.com and download it.
Gather a programmable floor robot such as a Bee-Bot or a Code-and-Go Robot Mouse.
Choose a song with a steady beat.
Review the robot's command menu before class.
Charge the robot and test one short sequence.
Let students dance like robots before they program.
Finish with the reflection questions on the page.
